reviews.text:
I've been going there since my little Westie was born 15 years ago!

She's a lovely, caring woman who adores animals.

A huge thank you for her enthusiasm and unwavering professionalism.
Quality, respect, kindness, and professionalism, all at a very reasonable price…
Thanks again…🐶
Tres Bon. Kind , listeners, good price , and comprehensive ! I totally recommend

So happy!! My little Oreo came out looking beautiful from Toutou des Épinettes.
The two people who work there are truly lovely and patient 🙏 quality work and very kind shopkeepers, thank you so much! …
A reliable place for grooming my dog; he always comes out looking great. The groomer is lovely and the prices are reasonable.

Our 3-year-old Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever just had her first grooming experience at Toutou des Épinettes, and I have to admit, it was a bit of a challenge!

It was a complete success! Trissy looks beautiful, perfectly groomed in keeping with her breed. Beyond the impeccable service, Sylvie and Patrick are passionate about their work; they love dogs, and it shows! Our naturally anxious dog remained calm and relaxed—a dog's well-being is priceless! I recommend this grooming salon 200%! I'm thrilled! ☺️

You can go there with your eyes closed.

A very pleasant lady who loves her job.
It was my dog's first time and I'm completely satisfied.
Thank you very much.
First appointment for my miniature poodle and I am very happy with the result, the welcome and the professionalism - I will not go anywhere else and I recommend 100%.
Excellent groomer. Fair price.
I have an appointment for 5:30 pm and I'm thrilled because my Yorkie doesn't want me to brush him anymore: hair everywhere! And you'll see how it goes early on time!

I leave my two Yorkshire Terriers with complete confidence. Sylvie is very professional; she has been grooming my little Yorkshire Terriers for several years now, and they always come out looking so beautiful. Thank you, Sylvie.

First grooming session at Toutou des Épinettes for our cocker spaniel! Very satisfied! The team is very friendly, professional and very patient, my dog ​​looks great, even though there was a lot of work to do! I recommend them 100%.
Second grooming appointment for Talya, American Cocker Spaniel. She came out looking beautiful and the lady was very friendly, go there without hesitation! 😘😘😘😘😘 …

First appointment, very happy with the result. Sylvie managed to fix the mess left by "Au Toutou Chic." Very friendly and gentle. Héliot immediately felt comfortable and not stressed at all. I recommend her 100%. Thanks again, Sylvie.
Very happy to have been a loyal customer for 2 years. Top-notch service!
First grooming at Toutou des Épinettes and we are extremely happy! The people who work there are extremely kind and professional and my dog ​​looks so handsome!

The people there are lovely. I went there in an emergency to have my nails trimmed, they didn't charge me anything, and were wonderful with my King Charles! I'll be going back soon for a spring grooming.

Excellent salon. I leave my dog ​​there with complete confidence. After several disappointing experiences at other Parisian salons, I chose Toutou Des Épinettes without the slightest hesitation. It's not a trendy dog ​​grooming salon, nor a showroom, nor a welcoming, cafe-like space. It's a place where your dog will be well cared for with attention, kindness, and professionalism. I'm so glad I found this place!
Excellent place ✨ A very kind lady who takes the time to look after my Lilo. Excellent value for money! I recommend it 100%!
Excellent dog grooming service
We really enjoyed our visit to the grooming salon.
I went there to have my dog's nails trimmed, and the lady who works there is super professional and kind. She's quick and meticulous; I highly recommend her ;)

❤️❤️🐕 I've been taking Bounty there every time she sheds for the past three years. I highly recommend it. The manager is absolutely lovely.

You can tell she adores animals.
Every time I take my little darling there, she looks beautiful when she leaves. A real princess! 👑✨ I totally recommend it! 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾

The person who runs this place is absolutely lovely. She loves dogs, and it shows. You need to book an appointment two months in advance because of her excellent reputation. She doesn't take large dogs because she's been bitten. Nail trims don't require an appointment.
The door is always locked; you have to knock to be let in.

I recommend it.

Hello, a first for us today at your salon 😊 for our little Cana d'Amour.

Very competent, patient, kind, and reasonably priced. My Cana came out looking …
The owner was very kind and reliable, the price was reasonable, I don't regret taking my dog ​​there. I recommend it.
We discovered this salon and Max, our poodle, came out transformed! We are so happy! Thank you for your professionalism and kindness to us and to Max.
A very nice haircut for my Coton de Tulear, who remained calm and collected. The groomer was gentle and calm. My dog ​​and I are very happy.
Excellent value for money. Friendly groomer!
